name: Sample Garden Apartments (synthetic)
description: A fictional 128-unit, 1985 garden community underwritten as a stabilized deal. Every name, unit and amount is invented. Use it to learn the flow before a real deal.
notes: Immediate capex of $192,000 ($1,500/unit) is an analyst figure for two roof replacements, funded with equity at close.
No PCA: the 1985 vintage is flagged for one (CAPEX_PCA_MISSING).
R&M plus turnover is $750/unit, under the 1980s floor of $900/unit: underwriting warns, pricing raises it to the floor.
The geography is synthetic, so market data falls back to flagged house values.
